records.entity: Central Bank of Iraq vault, Baghdad
records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: The Central Bank of Iraq's 2025 financial statements split the holding into three lines in note 4: gold reserve abroad, gold reserve at the CBI vault and gold coins at the CBI vault. Only the bank's own vault is named; the note names no institution for the much larger holding held abroad, so that part is recorded as a blank rather than guessed at.
records.source_title: Central Bank of Iraq, Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, note 4 'Gold reserve and gold revaluation reserve'
records.quote: Gold reserve at CBI vault 753,950 ... Gold coins at CBI vault 5,926

records.entity: Central Bank of the Russian Federation vaults, Russia
records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: Russia holds 2,283 tonnes, the third largest holding on the map. The Bank of Russia's own Annual Report 2025 says only that the assets are stored in Russia, naming no institution; the record is the Bank's own statement, quoted by Interfax, that all of the gold sits in its own vaults on Russian territory.
records.source_title: Interfax, 'CBR has taken no gold out of Russia, it is all in regulator's storage facilities', quoting the Bank of Russia
records.quote: All gold from our foreign exchange reserves is in CBR vaults in Russian territory.

records.entity: Banque Centrale des Comores strongroom, Moroni
records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: The Banque Centrale des Comores' 2024 auditor's report, note 5, puts eighteen bars in the bank's own strongroom in Moroni.
records.source_title: Banque Centrale des Comores, Rapport du commissaire aux comptes et etats financiers au 31 decembre 2024, note 5 'Avoirs en or'
